subject: science
domain: From Molecules to Organisms: Structures and Processes

items.prompt:
Which lists the levels of organization from smallest to largest?
A) Organ, tissue, cell, system
B) Cell, tissue, organ, organ system
C) Tissue, cell, system, organ
D) System, organ, tissue, cell
items.answer: B) Cell, tissue, organ, organ system

steps: Cells form tissues, tissues form organs, organs form systems.

items.prompt:
A group of similar cells working together is a:
A) Organ
B) Tissue
C) System
D) Molecule

steps: Similar cells grouped together make a tissue.

items.prompt:
Which system breaks down food into nutrients?
A) Respiratory
B) Circulatory
C) Digestive
D) Nervous

steps: The digestive system breaks food into usable nutrients.

items.prompt:
Which system carries oxygen and nutrients to cells throughout the body?
A) Digestive
B) Circulatory
C) Respiratory
D) Skeletal

steps: The circulatory system transports materials in the blood.

items.prompt:
The digestive and circulatory systems work together because:
A) They both make oxygen
B) Digestion releases nutrients that circulation delivers
C) They are the same system
D) Neither one interacts
items.answer: B) Digestion releases nutrients that circulation delivers

steps: The digestive system releases nutrients and the circulatory system delivers them.

items.prompt:
Several different tissues combine to form the heart. The heart is an example of a(n):
A) Cell
B) Tissue
C) Organ
D) Organ system

steps: An organ is made of different tissues working together.

items.prompt:
During exercise, muscle cells need more oxygen. Which pair of systems responds together to meet this need?
A) Digestive and skeletal
B) Respiratory and circulatory
C) Nervous and digestive
D) Skeletal and respiratory

steps: The respiratory system takes in more oxygen and the circulatory system speeds its delivery.

items.prompt:
Why is it accurate to describe the body as a 'system of interacting subsystems'?
A) Each organ system works alone
B) Each organ system performs part of the work and depends on the others
C) The body has only one system
D) Systems never interact
items.answer: B) Each organ system performs part of the work and depends on the others

steps: The body functions because its subsystems cooperate and depend on each other.
